current_versions.wgsl_spec: W3C Candidate Recommendation Draft; current TR snapshot line includes CRD 16 Jul 2026 (per gpuweb-tracked snapshots); still not a final Recommendation
current_versions.naga: Versioned with wgpu, not 0.x: e.g. naga 27.0.3 via wgpu 27 and naga 30.0.1 via wgpu 30.0.1 in current projects
current_versions.wgpu: 30.0.1 latest published line seen in current sources; Bevy pins its own wgpu - take the version from Bevy, not wgpu latest
current_versions.wesl: wesl-rs 0.6.0 released (WESL is the WGSL superset/tooling successor to the old wgsl-extensions direction)
current_versions.wgslfmt: Guide's formatter; current release state not verified from a primary page in this pass

error_handling.guide_position: Shader-creation error -> log, fall back to a safe material, never black screen silently; requires/enable documented per shader
error_handling.best_practice: Spec still defines shader-creation and pipeline-creation errors as the failure surface; application-side fallback remains the correct host pattern
error_handling.evidence: WGSL TR defines creation-error behaviour and, for subgroups, pipeline-creation errors for override expressions

bounded_work.guide_position: Named constants with units, guarded divisions, statically determinable or constant-bounded loops, per-pixel ALU/texture budgets
bounded_work.best_practice: Still sound and uncontradicted; spec loop and override semantics unchanged in ways that affect this
bounded_work.evidence: No contradiction in the current TR fetched

assertions_contracts.guide_position: Contracts per shader (inputs, bindings, backends, fallback) plus requires directives as machine-checked documentation
assertions_contracts.best_practice: Spec supports compile-time assumption checks on constant expressions and requires-style language extensions; contract-first documentation remains valid
assertions_contracts.evidence: WGSL TR introduction notes statements can check assumptions at shader creation time on constant expressions

memory_ownership.guide_position: No ownership; guide covers address spaces, binding-slot ownership by the engine, and uniform/storage layout instead
memory_ownership.best_practice: Does not apply: WGSL has address spaces and host-owned resources, no in-shader ownership/lifetimes
memory_ownership.evidence: Aspect does not apply to a shader language; nearest analogue (bindings/layout) is covered in the guide

formatting.guide_position: Format with wgslfmt; 4 spaces, no tabs
formatting.best_practice: wgslfmt's current release/maintenance state was not verified from a primary source in this pass, and WESL tooling now provides its own formatting path
formatting.evidence: Marked unverified: no citation fetched for wgslfmt's current state; do not claim it is dead or current

static_analysis.guide_position: Validate with naga CLI (imports stripped), wgsl-analyzer diagnostics, portability test, screenshot; validation record says naga 0.x
static_analysis.best_practice: Naga is no longer a 0.x standalone story: it ships versioned inside wgpu (27.x/30.x lines), and naga coverage lags the spec, so the validator version must be pinned to the wgpu/Bevy in use; WESL tooling (wesl-rs 0.6.0) is now an alternative front end
static_analysis.evidence: Current projects pin naga 27.0.3 via wgpu 27 and wgpu/naga 30.0.1; wesl-rs v0.6.0 release exists

concurrency.guide_position: Uniformity discipline for derivative/texture ops; blanket rule: no subgroup operations without the subgroups extension, restructure over suppressing derivative_uniformity
concurrency.best_practice: Spec now formalises subgroups, subgroup_id, subgroup_size_control and quad operations as named language extensions with uniformity scopes (subgroup_uniformity), so guidance should be extension-gated and specific, not a blanket avoidance
concurrency.evidence: WGSL TR: subgroups extension enables subgroup/quad builtins, subgroup_size_control enables the subgroup_size attribute, and uniformity analysis gained a subgroup scope

testing.guide_position: Four gates: naga validation, portability test (tests/shader_render.rs), wgsl-analyzer, screenshot on target hardware
testing.best_practice: Still the right gate shape; naga alone cannot catch visual bugs, as the guide says
testing.evidence: Uncontradicted; version pinning caveat is under toolchain_pins/static_analysis

toolchain_pins.guide_position: Pin the validator version and record it; spec baseline is the W3C TR; validation record dated 2026-10-06 says naga 0.x
toolchain_pins.best_practice: Current TR line is the Jul 2026 CRD; validator must be recorded as the wgpu/naga version actually used by the pinned Bevy, not 0.x
toolchain_pins.evidence: TR snapshots tracked at CRD-WGSL 16 Jul 2026; naga versions in current use are 27.x/30.x via wgpu

security.guide_position: Portability-as-safety, no f64, feature checks before enable directives, fallback material defined before writing the shader
security.best_practice: WGSL remains a sandboxed, statically typed shader language with creation-time validation; guide's defence-in-depth (feature check + fallback) matches the spec model
security.evidence: WGSL TR: language is statically typed with limited implicit conversions and creation-time checks

mechanical_fixes.evidence: Constant name is misspelled (SOFNTESS for SOFTNESS) in the section 6 bounds example; the guide's own naming rules require names that expose role/units

mechanical_fixes.current: - naga 0.x: 4 shaders validated (glow, pulse, atmosphere, wipe).
mechanical_fixes.correct: - naga <version matching the pinned wgpu/Bevy, e.g. naga 30.0.1 via wgpu 30.0.1>: 4 shaders validated (glow, pulse, atmosphere, wipe).
mechanical_fixes.evidence: Naga ships versioned with wgpu in current releases (naga 27.0.3 via wgpu 27; naga 30.0.1 via wgpu 30.0.1); a 0.x record is a stale pin and section 2 of the same guide requires recording the exact validator version

proposals.proposal: Replace the blanket subgroup avoidance with extension-gated guidance: enable subgroups / subgroup_size_control only with a host feature check, document subgroup_uniformity diagnostics, and keep the GLES/WebGL2 fallback path subgroup-free
proposals.evidence: Current WGSL TR defines subgroups, subgroup_id and subgroup_size_control as language extensions with defined uniformity scopes and creation/pipeline errors
proposals.recommendation: Adopt for compute-capable targets only; keep the portable 2D subset subgroup-free as the default

proposals.proposal: Evaluate WESL (wesl-rs 0.6.0) as the successor tooling path for imports/composition instead of hand-stripping Bevy #import lines for validation, and pin naga via the project's wgpu/Bevy version in the validation record
proposals.evidence: wesl-rs v0.6.0 is a current release; the guide's strip-imports workaround is a manual step WESL-style tooling exists to eliminate; naga version is determined by wgpu in current projects
proposals.recommendation: Trial on one shader first (guide's own trial-on-one rule); do not swap the validator fleet-wide without a screenshot gate pass
